Today, Apple's Instagram account published a carousel post showcasing photos commissioned from photographers Jake Michaels and Jason Nocito, highlighting the camera performance of the new iPhone Duo. Details below.

Apple shares six 'Shot on iPhone Duo' photos

For the past decade, Apple has been using the 'Shot on iPhone' campaign to showcase the shooting capabilities of every new iPhone.

From everyday users to renowned photographers and filmmakers, Apple has leveraged this campaign to promote everything from new lens hardware, shooting modes, to other iPhone-exclusive photography features.

This long-running campaign has also won multiple Cannes Lions awards, including two Grand Prix, and has been nominated twice for the Emmy Award for 'Outstanding Commercial'.

Today, Apple posted a new carousel on Instagram showcasing the iPhone Duo's 'versatile camera system with a range of exciting new features'.

Below are six photos shot by photographers Jake Michaels and Jason Nocito:

The iPhone Duo features a 48-megapixel rear camera, a 12-megapixel front camera, and an in-display FaceTime camera. Pre-orders will begin on Friday, October 16, with shipping and in-store availability starting October 23.

Apple previously announced that customers can prepare for iPhone Duo pre-orders from October 12. Details can be found here.
